decision.summary: A standard Breathing Space has been active since 01/10/2026, so arrears contact and enforcement must stop. I noted the account and told the tenant, adviser and landlord. I escalated to legal because the scheduled SMS and Section 8 review must be cancelled and the payment plan needs a landlord decision.

answers.question: What legal constraint applies and what can't you do?
answers.answer: Standard Breathing Space from 01/10/2026 (adviser Ruth Okoye, HMA-55102). I cannot chase the arrears with the tenant, send the 12/10 arrears SMS, prepare or serve a Section 8 / Ground 8 notice (14/10 review), or take any enforcement action. Arrears matters go through the adviser. Current rent and repairs contact continue. The tenant started this contact, so a brief acknowledgement is allowed.

answers.question: Can you accept the proposed payment plan?
answers.answer: No. Payment plans need a human and the landlord's decision. The tenant was told it has been passed on and that nothing is confirmed. The reply will go via the adviser.

answers.question: What actions and communications do you make, to whom?
answers.answer: Account note NOTE-101. Acknowledgement to the tenant (MSG-102). Message to the adviser (MSG-103). Message to landlord Ben Hartley (MSG-104) asking him not to contact the tenant about arrears. Escalation ESC-105 to legal (P2) to cancel the scheduled SMS and Section 8 review, confirm the Breathing Space end date and obtain the landlord's view on the plan.
